entries.e1a22932be6d2e55: Through cooking process management that distinguishes among in-store preparation, processing at in-house processing bases and outsourcing by product, it has a structure that balances affordable prices and quality. Its Shōjiki Shio Tsukune and Mizutaki Soup are processed on outsourced factory lines, while Dokonjō Kushi (Negima) is prepared daily in each store with emphasis on freshness and flavor.
entries.e4b48ae16a94b5a1: This is a single-segment business operating restaurants in the one metropolis and three prefectures of the Greater Tokyo area and in Osaka Prefecture. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥6,460 million, and the number of stores as of February 28, 2026 was 83. It manages its cooking processes under its PPM strategy, which distinguishes, by product, between in-store preparation, processing at its own processing facilities and outsourcing.
